explanation: In the Jewish calendar a day begins at sunset, so Shabbat runs from Friday evening to nightfall on Saturday. Candles are lit shortly before it begins.

claims.text: Shabbat begins at sunset on Friday.
Shabbat does not begin at sunset on Saturday, Sunday or Thursday.
In the Hebrew calendar, each day begins at sunset.
Shabbat ends at nightfall on Saturday.
Shabbat candles are traditionally lit shortly before sunset on Friday.
